Each region is checked separately for colour anomalies and whitening. Print, foil and cut alignment can resemble damage. Open a region to inspect the photo and record what you see.

Your observations are kept for this photo session and used for the experimental range. They do not certify condition or override poor photo quality. Recorded damage broadens or lowers the estimated range.
Visible damage was recorded. The overall model estimate is withheld because manual findings are not calibrated model inputs. Centering results do not account for this damage.
Corners and edges need closer inspection. Missing or inconclusive evidence prevents an overall model estimate; centering alone does not establish a grade.
